title: Live view
hint: See and hear the camera now. Video is not stored; it goes straight from the camera to your device. The camera screen shows that someone is watching.
hintCctv: See and hear the camera now. Nothing is recorded; the view closes by itself after 10 minutes.
offline: Live view is available while the camera is online.
blocked: The privacy curtain is on at the camera
busy: Several people are watching this camera. Wait a moment and try again.
timeout: The camera did not answer. Check that the camera page is open on the phone.
failed: Couldn't connect. Check your network and try again.
